notes: Exposure began at OD595 ~0.47 during exponential growth; all samples within 60 min, so mid_exponential kept from the summary. Unexposed samples at every time point are controls. PMA (organomercurial) labelled metal_excess like HgCl2. WT re-read: unmodified MG1655, genotype_class wild_type (inferred).

base_medium.q: Neidhardt MOPS Minimal Medium (NM3) (Neidhardt et al., 1974, J Bacteriol) (0.2% final glucose concentration) supplemented with 20 mg/L uracil and 500 µg/L thiamine

medium_class.q: Neidhardt MOPS Minimal Medium (NM3) (Neidhardt et al., 1974, J Bacteriol) (0.2% final glucose concentration) supplemented with 20 mg/L uracil and 500 µg/L thiamine

oxygen.q: which were incubated at 37°C with shaking at 250 rpm

growth_phase.q: Gene expression changes during exponential growth of E. coli MG1655 were compared by RNA-seq
